newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows surge in 2-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows surge in 2-day period - survey.

text.p: U.S. stock mutual funds recorded inflows of $1.3 billion for the two-day period ended March 26, compared to outflows of $107 million for the previous three-day period, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

Aggressive growth funds recorded a reversal to inflows of $333 million versus outflows of $49 million, while growth funds posted inflows of $204 million versus outflows of $139 million, the fund tracking firm said.
Growth and income funds had inflows of $661 million versus inflows of $150 million.

Bond funds recorded outflows of $174 million versus inflows of $47 million, the firm said. Muni funds had outflows of $248 million versus inflows of $100 million, while flexible/balanced/mixed funds had inflows of $272 million versus outflows of $15 million.
